text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, with Tanino Gimlet's debut race drawing near—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh heh...! The blessing of the new wind gods... I can feel it without a doubt in these legs...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what's your assessment?
choice_data_list: Yeah, your stability has really improved.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Heading into her debut race, Tanino Gimlet trains diligently, steadily polishing her innate strength.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Besides, despite her complex vocabulary, I felt myself getting used to the gap between her words and her earnest, straightforward dedication to training.
—Um! Gimlet-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me for barging in right after training!
There's something I just have to say to you, Gimlet-senpai—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who appeared is named Vodka.
She gives off a lively impression and is Tanino Gimlet's junior.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —I don't mind, Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Offer your words unto me.
...Expose your soul, without falsehood.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Th-That's so cool...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's not what I meant!
—Senpai, your debut race is right around the corner, right?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm rooting for you with ev-er-y-thing I've got!
I'm definitely going to watch in person on race day!
So, um... give it your all!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh—
That's so like you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Very well. Then stand at the very forefront,
and etch my run into your mind!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
However, do not forget...!
A vivid brilliance can sometimes turn into a sharp blade—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Be fiercely mindful of your true self!
That alone will shield what lies within you
from the scorching heat of my frenzy—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Y-Yes! Heee ve gooo!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Good girl.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. After this,
let Vodka and me run tandem just once.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh!? A tandem run with Gimlet-senpai!?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. Rest assured, this is no frivolous proposition.
I simply wish to test the sensation of today's blessing through a tandem run as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Besides—this isn't a bad deal for Vodka either.
I'm going all out. Feel my heat, and let it fuel you.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
F-For real...!?
But, umm—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her sudden proposal took me by surprise,
but I understood her intention of wanting to test the results
of her training by running together.
choice_data_list: Got it. If you'd prefer Vodka, then...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course it's okay!
I'll be in your care!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, on short notice, it was decided that Tanino Gimlet and Vodka would run a tandem workout together—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —WOOOOOAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, as expected, Gim-senpai is amazing...!
But since we're running together,
I won't back down either...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Oryaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Th-Thank you so much...!
I really... learned a lot...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
No thanks are needed.
If anything, I'm the one who should be grateful.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That impulse of yours, sparked in mid-stride—
it stirred me quite nicely.
Allow me to make it fuel for my upcoming debut race.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: After this, we were going to take a peek into Niflheim to cool down all this heat, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's cool down and call it a day.
Yeah, let's cool down and call it a day.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Consider it my thanks, Vodka.
If you're up for it, I'll treat you to a drink after this.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean... a mocktail made by you, Senpai!?
Are you sure!? I super wanna drink it!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It's settled.
—Trainer, how about you?
choice_data_list: Since we're here, maybe I'll have some.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I've been faintly sensing it for a while now,
but whenever Tanino Gimlet interacts with Vodka,
there's an aura that's slightly different from usual."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Part of me wanted to take a closer look
and see what made the difference—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: She looks so cool, every single time, su...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... It's too early to be enchanted.
The nectar transforms one's soul only when tasted.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Now, drink—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoa, good...! The moment you drink it, it's super refreshing, but then a huge burst of sweetness comes right after...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I've never tasted anything like this...!
Senpai, how on earth did you make it!?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Mystery is such because it remains silent and inexplicable.
For now, simply drown yourself in the tangible delicacies overflowing before you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Only by going that far can our souls finally unbind their shackles
and find rest, after all—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—A fine opportunity.
Vodka. Let me hear your words.
Speak whatever is on your mind.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Unleash your hidden anguish only once the shackles are removed.
Turn around and look upon your own shadow.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Um, are you saying it's okay for me
to talk to you about my worries, Senpai...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah.
Tonight, we shall offer it as an appetizer to the god of revelry.
And stone-sober, we shall observe the spectacle—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Speaking of which, lately I've been having a bit of trouble deciding what clothes to wear...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I was just picking out stuff I thought looked nice,
but now it feels kinda repetitive, like they're
all pretty much the same...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh.
That's just how true you are to your own soul.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Clothing can sometimes reflect the soul more clearly than the flesh. The pleasure of dressing up requires, first and foremost, looking closely at how you wish to be—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Choosing similar things by following the voice of your soul
is, in a sense, only natural.
There is no need to worry about it whatsoever."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I see...!
If you like what you like, then there's just no helping it, huh!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“Indeed. Yet, defying reason at times,
making contradictory choices, and inviting chaos
is a form of destruction that creates new frontiers.”

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh. Slipping into an outfit unlike anything I've ever worn before might not be so bad after all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
C-Clothes I've never worn before?
...Like what Scarlet wears...?
No, no, that's way too out there—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Gim-senpai!
Thank you so, so much for today!
I had a ton of fun!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"—Do not let yourself be swept away
by sweet, beautiful memories.
Accept a peaceful slumber for tonight."
choice_data_list: Thanks for running alongside me today.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No! Good work to you too,
Gym-senpai and Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say they are a special existence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beneath Tanino Gimlet's words, I could feel
a deep, powerful emotion that went far beyond mere speech...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Do you believe in cycles? Do you feel destiny?
choice_data_list: What do you mean by that...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Do you remember? The eternal tale of Tanino Gimlet
that I unraveled for you before—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That day, when Father showed me how I ought to be—
I felt deeply within myself
that the gears of destiny had begun to turn.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The thumping heartbeat when I was guided toward mythology—
it was an impact so profound, it felt as though my very existence had transformed before and after...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: In my history up to this day, I have only felt that same sensation—twice.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...I saw it. Heard it. Felt it.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
When I met Vodka—
I felt that very same shock of destiny.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —The utterly pure "fervor" dwelling inside her.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That will surely wreak devastating destruction
and usher in immense chaos in the future.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
I sensed it intuitively, as if I had seen it with my own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—The beginning of him seeking me out.
Because there is a sense of destiny and cycles intertwining there,
I cannot ignore his intuition—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, Vodka is—
special to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...I probably don't fully understand the true meaning behind Tanino Gimlet's words. But even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka was someone so important to her that it felt like fate.
If nothing else, that much was clear.
choice_data_list: —Gotta show what we're made of in the debut race.
—We need to put on a good show for your debut race.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
I cannot leave an incomplete brand upon an innocent soul.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A brilliant radiance signaling the opening act—
I shall be sure to put it on full display.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Along with seeing a slightly unexpected side of Tanino Gimlet, it became a day that strengthened my resolve toward her debut race—
